messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-98127 fired: GPU_MEMORY_PRESSURE on infer-west2a pool. Severity: P1. Affected nodes: infer-west2a-*-gpu (12/24 GPUs reporting high alloc failures). Symptoms: repeated cudaMalloc failures and kvcache evictions. Links: https://pd.redwood/p/P-98127 · runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/gpu-memory

sam: acked via PD. I'm up. grabbing quick metrics now.

aubrey: taking lead — will run targeted evacuation for hottest jobs and scale fallback pool to keep latency SLOs.

marta: saw this start ~12:34 UTC, eviction spikes + mem growth on a single model variant. snippet from node logs: ```[12:34:09] WARN kvcache: evict_count=612; [12:34:10] ERROR cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory; pid=4421 model=redwood/generate-v2 seq=1024```

sam: sounds like kvcache fanout. Can you confirm if prefix caching increased?

marta: yes — prefix hit rate dropped and evictions jumped 8x after a load burst. probably long context requests + aggressive prefetch.

incident-bot: Action suggestion from playbook: start-evacuation -> cordon affected nodes -> spin up fallback pool (gpu-small) -> reroute new requests to fallback.

aubrey: doing cordon now: `kubectl label node infer-west2a-12 cordoned=memory-evac --overwrite`. starting evacuation script.

lee: oncall-secondary here. I'll open a short-lived bypass: route model variants to quantized-128 option to reduce KV size. Patch: `routing.set_policy("fallback-quant128", weight=0.6)`

sam: executing fallback spin-up: `infra autoscale --pool=gpu-small --count=6 --reason="P-98127 fallback"`

marta: confirm: scaled fallback + routing in place. observing reduced allocation failures on new requests. legacy jobs still on hot nodes — evacuating slowly to avoid thrash.

aubrey: manual eviction of long-running tasks on infer-west2a-12/17/19. issuing `taskctl preempt --age>300s --pool=infer-west2a` 

incident-bot: PD update posted to P-98127: "Evac + fallback in progress; degradation observed, customer impact limited to increased latency for heavy seq requests. No data loss."

sam: contacting uptime/sales for customer heads-up. cc: @oncall-secondary for any handoff.

oncall-secondary: saw customer spike on embeddings pipeline — temporarily throttling batch size to 128. Noted in customer-impact doc.

marta: small note — one node returns a cudaSigbus in dmesg for kernel 515. patching driver not possible in-prod; will retire node after evacuation. log: ```[12:36:01] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:02:00): 79, PID 4421, GPU 0```

aubrey: marking node infer-west2a-19 for retire. `nodepool retire infer-west2a-19 --drain --force-after=10m`

sam: starting PD escalation timeline message: ETA to recovery baseline ~18m if evac finishes without churn.

incident-bot: Auto-mitigation summary: cordoned 3 nodes, spun up 6 gpu-small instances, routing fallback policy applied, one node flagged for retirement, customer impact flagged: elevated latency for long-context gen.

lee: monitoring tail latencies and OOMs. early signal: p50 stable, p95 improved but still 2x baseline for large seqs.

marta: dropping prefetch aggressiveness on model variant via config: `models/redwood/generate-v2/settings.prefetch=0.3` -> pushing now.

aubrey: evac complete for flagged nodes. starting graceful reboot on retired node.

sam: PD note: teams to verify postmortem entry; capture trigger (kvcache eviction surge + long-context requests). tagging infra + runtime.

oncall-secondary: handing back to sam in 20m for postmortem draft.

incident-bot: PD P-98127 acknowledged by sam and auto-ack closed by operator at 12:56 UTC. Final status: mitigated -> routing fallback stable. Recommend follow-up: change default prefetch for large-context routes, add kvcache eviction alarm threshold.

sam: thanks all. I'll start the postmortem and schedule a short retro with runtime and infra tomorrow. closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
